title: Judge practice and decision record intake contract

judge_and_court.description: Official identity, court and sourced assignment; do not infer a matter assignment from a profile image.

practice_and_decision_sources.description: Official rules/profile pages and readable orders/opinions with dates and jurisdiction.

items.description: Source/record descriptor; resolve its identity, access and content via a host-validated adapter.

cohort_protocol.description: Motion type, time window, unit of analysis, exclusions and treatment of partial/withdrawn/appealed rulings.

authorized_disclosure_scope.description: Specific public official disclosure records and entity identifiers for an expressly requested review; omit unrelated personal details.

$comment: The host must validate nested source descriptors against its actual DTOs. This specification deliberately does not fabricate production API shapes.
